stem: Before the widespread use of antibiotics (c. 1928–1933), what percentage of deaths in Los Angeles County Hospital were attributed to complications of otitis media?
explanation: The source mentions that $25$ per every $1000$ deaths (which is $2.5\%$) were due to complications from otitis media during that period.
rationale: Convert the statistic '25 every thousand' into a percentage.

optionExplanations.A: The source mentions that $25$ per every $1000$ deaths (which is $2.5\%$) were due to complications from otitis media during that period.
optionExplanations.B: $10\%$ refers to the percentage of hospital beds occupied by patients with these complications, not the mortality rate.
optionExplanations.C: This figure is too low; the lecture emphasizes that otitis media was a very serious and relatively common cause of death pre-antibiotics.
optionExplanations.D: While serious, otitis media did not account for a quarter of all hospital deaths; the figure was $25$ out of $1000$.
